name: BOSReference
description: Hebrew OT and Greek NT numbering from Copenhagen org, plus explicitly sourced additional books and distinct witnesses. Counts describe a candidate address space, not verified text equivalence.

coreBasis.newTestament: UBS GNT / Nestle-Aland Greek versification convention

SNG.name: Song of Solomon / Song of Songs / Canticles / Canticle of Canticles

REV.name: Revelation / Revelation of John / Apocalypse of St. John

ESG.name: Greek Esther / Esther (Greek)
notes: Upstream maps use lettered addresses without a corresponding partialVerses declaration. Segment inventory and numbering need review.

SIR.name: Sirach / Ecclesiasticus / Wisdom of Ben Sira / Wisdom of Jesus son of Sirach

LJE.name: Letter of Jeremiah / Epistle of Jeremiah

PAZ.name: Prayer of Azariah and the Song of the Three Young Men / Prayer of Azariah / Song of the Three Young Men / Song of the Three Children
notes: Retain org count 67. Upstream mappings include verse 68 and absent DAG destinations; resolve the bridge before conversion.

GES.name: Greek Esdras / Greek Ezra / 1 Esdras / 1 Ezra / 2 Ezra / 3 Ezra / 3 Esdras

LES.name: Latin Esdras / 2 Esdras / 3 Esdras / 4 Esdras / 4 Ezra

MAN.name: Prayer of Manasses / Prayer of Manasseh

BLT.name: Bel and the dragon θ / Bel and the dragon Th

EZA.name: Apocalypse of Ezra / Ezra Apocalypse / 4 Ezra / Ezra Shealtiel

JUB.name: Jubilees
notes: Retain the upstream Ethiopian chapter structure; it is not asserted to cover every edition of Jubilees.

ENO.name: Enoch / 1 Enoch / Ethiopic Apocalypse of Enoch
notes: Retain the upstream Ethiopian chapter structure; it is not asserted to cover every edition of Enoch.

DNG.name: Greek Daniel / Daniel (Greek)
notes: Greek Daniel is a target of org mappings but has no org count definition. Use the lxx 12-chapter layout as a provisional Greek composite view. Shared Hebrew passages and Greek additions require an explicit bridge; this is not a new independent copy of those passages.

LAO.name: Letter to the Laodiceans
notes: Letter to the Laodiceans has 20 verses in both vul and eng; use the Latin-tradition source. No cross-tradition mapping is asserted.

EZ6.name: 6 Ezra / 5 Esdras / 6 Esdras
notes: Latin 6 Ezra has a two-chapter definition. Its relationship to the larger Ezra/Esdras works needs a verified bridge.

MQ1.name: 1 Meqabyan / 1 Makabian / Mekabis of Benjamin
notes: Only this snapshot supplies these Meqabyan counts. The enclosing custom file is incomplete/underspecified; verify the edition and completeness before conversion.

MQ3.name: 3 Meqabyan / 3 Makabian
notes: Only this snapshot supplies these Meqabyan counts; 2 Meqabyan remains absent. Verify the edition and completeness before conversion.

REP.name: Reproof / Tegsas / Tegsats / Taagsas
notes: Provisional Ethiopian Reproof counts; verify the edition and completeness before conversion.

BA4.name: 4 Baruch / Paralipomenon of Jeremiah / Paraleipomena Ieremiou / Rest of the Words of Baruch
notes: Provisional 4 Baruch counts; verify the edition and completeness before conversion.

mappingRestrictions.reason: The upstream standard-mappings README explicitly states that no Vulgate-to-Septuagint mappings are supplied for these books because their Vorlage differs. Absence of a rule must not become identity.

unresolvedBridgeDecisions: Preserve Hebrew DAN numbering in the reference core. Greek DAG/DNG is a composite view whose shared passages and additions need an explicit bridge.
Preserve Greek Esther, standalone Daniel additions, Letter of Jeremiah, and distinct Greek witnesses as separate catalogue entries until their equivalences are verified.
Resolve overlapping Ezra/Esdras works and extracts without creating duplicate canonical passage identities.
Latin Tobit, Judith, and Sirach need verified separate witness addresses or mappings; the present catalogue does not establish these.
